title: NVIDIA Chooses Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for AI Services
snippet: NVIDIA has selected OCI as the first hyperscale cloud provider to offer NVIDIA DGX Cloud, an AI supercomputing service, at massive scale.

title: Oracle and NVIDIA to Deliver Sovereign AI Worldwide
snippet: To meet escalating customer demand for increasingly complex AI models, the companies are adding NVIDIA Grace Blackwell to NVIDIA DGX Cloud on OCI.

title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Deploys Thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs for Agentic AI and Reasoning Models
snippet: Oracle has stood up and optimized its first wave of liquid-cooled NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 racks in its data centers. Thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs are now being deployed.

title: Oracle and NVIDIA stocks both rise on AI optimism
snippet: Shares of Oracle and NVIDIA both climbed on Tuesday amid broad AI sector optimism, analysts noted.
